subject: Marketplace procurement & commercial path — follow-up and next steps
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 15:20:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & marketplace interest

Hi Samir — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Call highlights:
- Goal: LumenAI wants to evaluate Redwood for inference serving for production ML workloads (initial focus: model hosting and inference for their analytics product).
- Procurement constraints: procurement requires either a PO (Net 30) or marketplace purchase; credit card for smaller pilots is acceptable but anything above ~$25k needs PO and SOW.
- Marketplace interest: preferred path is AWS Marketplace, but team is open to GCP depending on timeline and contract flexibility.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 Type II and data residency details required by legal/infosec.

Proposed next steps:
1) I attached a short Marketplace Path overview + the latest pricing sheet (Redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx). Please confirm whether AWS Marketplace is the preferred route.
2) If PO: can you share procurement contact and standard PO flow + approximate signature timeline?
3) If Marketplace: we’ll map the procurement steps (procurement approvals, marketplace listing time, billing setup).
4) Marissa (cc) will scope a pilot SOW and clarify any billing/legal prerequisites.

Ask for you: can you confirm procurement contact, whether procurement prefers PO vs marketplace, and an estimated timeline for decision (2–4 weeks, or longer)?

Thanks — happy to sync again if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments:
- Redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx
- Marketplace-path-overview.pdf
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumenai.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Thomas <ava.thomas@lumenai.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & marketplace interest

Thanks for the clear recap, Camila — useful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement contact: Ava Thomas (cc'd) handles vendor onboarding. Ava — I'll let you confirm the exact PO steps.
- PO vs marketplace: For enterprise purchases (above ~25k) procurement prefers a PO on file; however, they are exploring AWS Marketplace as it speeds up internal approvals for SaaS purchases. If Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace with private offers, that would be our preferred path.
- Timeline: We have a vendor review window the week of June 28; target decision by end of July if everything checks out.
- Security: Infosec will request SOC 2 Type II reports and an evidence bundle. Can you share a SOC 2 snapshot and a short data flow diagram for production?

One more thing — billing: procurement needs to know whether Redwood can accept marketplace billing (invoice through AWS) and also provide net-30 PO terms if marketplace isn't available.

Happy to jump on a quick call next week to walk Ava and procurement through the options if that helps.

Best,
Samir
Head of Platform Partnerships, LumenAI
samir@lumenai.com
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumenai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 18:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: procurement readiness & marketplace interest

Thanks Samir (and hi Ava) — appreciate the details. Quick answers and next actions: 

Answers:
- Marketplace: Yes — Redwood supports AWS Marketplace (we also have listings for GCP via Partner Marketplace). For enterprise deals we can offer a private offer through AWS Marketplace that allows you to accept marketplace procurement while preserving negotiated pricing/terms.
- PO terms: We can accept Net 30 on a PO for enterprise contracts. Typical process: we sign a master services agreement (MSA) and customer issues PO referencing the MSA + SOW.
- Security artifacts: attaching a SOC2 snapshot and a short production data flow diagram (see attachments). If infosec needs more, we can provide the full evidence bundle after an NDA.

Attachments included:
- SOC2-snapshot-2027.pdf
- Production-data-flow.png (diagram)
- Redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (attached again for Marissa to confirm)

Next actions / ask:
1) Ava — can you share the procurement contact email and any vendor onboarding checklist you use? That will help Marissa prep the SOW and legal to pre-populate terms.
2) Marissa — can you please prepare a one-page pilot SOW (30-day pilot, up to 50k tokens/day, success criteria: 99th percentile latency < 200ms on our standard benchmark) and a draft MSA with a marketplace addendum? I can route the SOC2 snapshot to Ava's team.
3) Samir/Ava — are you ok with the timeline of vendor review the week of Jun 28 and decision by end of July? If yes, we will prioritize the pilot SOW and marketplace private-offer paperwork.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call to walk procurement through the marketplace private-offer flow — suggest Wed 16 Jun or Thu 17 Jun, 10–11am PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks all,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

----

Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
